websites.title: Business websites
websites.description: Public sites to inspect read-only. Supply only domains you are authorized to audit. A maximum of 10 sites applies by default.

runtimeWitness.title: Confirm call buttons in a real browser
runtimeWitness.description: Re-reads contested call buttons in headless Chromium after the site's scripts (e.g. call tracking) run. Recommended.

maxSites.title: Maximum approved sites
maxSites.description: Hard ceiling on sites and runtime exposure. A longer input is rejected, not silently billed.
